reviews.text: Donothan does a geeat job with grooming my dog!!!
Amazing Job! Great work, my dog hates doctors and showers but they do a great job here never have a problem

We adopted our dog from a Doggie Style so we're biased but we've loved the grooming services with Donathan at the NoLibs location. Great store, great staff and our guy is always bouncy and fresh after a visit with Donathan.

Came here after my normal groomer in Fishtown was fired/he quit, because was told groomer here Donathan is an expert when it comes to huskies. Overall did a good job with shampoo/cleaning/trimming my dogs nails and paws etc.

However missed the most important part which was dematting her underside. I caught he didn’t address the knots behind her ears when I picked her up, so had to do that while I waited. When i initially dropped her off, I said her belly might need to be basically shaved. Upon arriving home I noticed he ignored the entire area that I asked to prioritize. These are the fur mats I had to manually cut off her underside today, they were tight as knots. I paid for the neat n up, which includes dematting.

Edit: I’m not misunderstanding the service I paid for. I have been a longtime customer and have previously paid à la carte for additional dematting time with the Neat N Up service at $10 per additional unit of time. I also specifically discussed my dog’s severe matting with the groomer at drop-off, including that her underside might need to be shaved, and was told it would be addressed.

The issue is not that I expected a body shave to be automatically included in the base service. The issue is that I specifically requested and discussed dematting, was willing to pay for the additional time as I have in the past, and the area I identified as the priority was left completely untouched.

I’m sharing my experience because I think customers should know exactly what to expect when booking these services. Rather than suggesting that I’m reviewing a service I never requested, I would have appreciated simply acknowledging the concern and addressing why the requested work wasn’t completed.

Unfortunately, this interaction is consistent with the customer-service concerns described in other reviews. I’m not going to characterize other customers’ experiences as fact, but there is clearly a pattern in the reviews of people feeling poorly treated or dismissed when they raise concerns.

I stand by my review. The work I specifically discussed and paid for was not completed, and the response to my complaint only reinforces my concerns about how customer issues are handled.

I’m not as satisfied with the cut my dog received. I asked to have her body cut all the way down it is not close. Except for her eyes being cut out her face looks the same. It is not even. It looks very ungroomed . I wanted it close. Worst cut ever. I use Doggie Style Pets often.Maybe I need to look for new groomer.

I asked for as close a shave for my Australian shepherd as possible because it’s the summer, and I walked away with half a groomed dog after spending $150 plus tip. I admit, I could’ve tipped more than $10 but my dog wasn’t finished, I didn’t get a full groom, and I didn’t get the full close-shave I asked for. His face/head didn’t smell like it was washed, which is included in the full groom, and I think they texted me that he was ready WELL before he actually was. Cause again, I asked for a full, close-shave and paid for a full grooming, which I really don’t believe was completed. If there’s an error with the online messaging system, I suggest fixing that ASAP/IMMEDIATELY bc I I was told to pick up my dog and he was ready , walked 15 minutes to the groomers, had to wait longer, and then when I got him, he still wasn’t finished like I asked for.

We recently moved from Florida and needed to find a new groomer for our poodle.  We were out exploring our neighborhood here in Northern Liberties and found Doggy Style Pets.  I looked on website and made a reservation for grooming.  The rep contacted me about vet records and helped get the info needed from our old vet in FL.  Took our baby in today and his haircut was long overdue but he came out looking amazing!  I also have to say all the groomers we used in FL charged a premium for poodles but DSP doesn't have anything like that and the total cost was about 1/2 the price of what we used to pay in FL..  Great service and a great haircut.  We will be back!
Our dogs can't get enough of NoLibs Doggie Style!

I really wanted to like this place because everyone was so sweet but I booked a full groom which on the app says “Full Groom Includes: Full haircut, bath 'n brush service, sanitary paw/pad trim, nail trim and ear cleaning.” I don’t think they even gave her a bath and they definitely didn’t do her nails. I normally do her grooming myself and I’m not a professional, but they just did a really sloppy job. I had to cut off several random long pieces on her back. The one of her on the couch is her before and the others are after.This is what she looks like after I asked for a teddy bear hair cut. I just feel like they didn’t do much. Like they didn’t even trim around her sanitary areas.
Donathan did an incredible job grooming my pup. Would highly recommend!
Great store and staff. The grooming staff always does an excellent job with our little princess

I’ll start with the good thing:  staff are very nice and attentive.

Ok now for the not so great:
We got our two poodles groomed here. I had heard great things about the grooming here by Donathon. I saw the other reviews and had high hopes that we too would get some great grooming. Unfortunately that just wasn’t the case. Our poodles unfortunately look terrible. We didn’t ask for anything special; just a clean and tidy trim and leave the tail a bit longer. Unfortunately there are numerous spots that were missed and overall looks very sloppy. One of our dogs had his front paws from the elbow down completely missed. I’m not sure that the ears were even cut or trimmed. I did initially ask that they fix the ears and faces but they came out looking worse than before so I decided to cut my losses. I’m going to stop into another location soon and see if they can fix them because I’m honestly in shock at how bad it looks. If there is a manager that oversees this account that wants me to stop in to show them the haircut results I’m happy to do so- and I’m sure you’ll agree with me. I know this isn’t the norm or the standard there; as I’ve heard great things. But either the groomer was having an off day or maybe poodles just aren’t his specialty.

I’m happy to update my review if this is made right. I know they were cut with good intentions and from what I’ve seen- you guys usually do a good job. I’m sure this was a “one off”.

EDIT:
Management did make this right. A few days after the initial groom, they had me visit their Fairmount location for 2 free regrooms with the two groomers at their fairmount location. These second grooms are AMAZING. While I can’t really recommend the northern liberties location for grooming; I HIGHLY recommend the fairmount location for grooming- specifically Ashli and Alexis.

Thank you to management for making this right. I will add a star.
Wonderful wonderful wonder

LeNiesha is great worker and willing to help me no matter if it was for my dog or cats. This was most top tier customer service i ever receive. I will definitely will be comeing back and getting my dog groomed going foward. Thanks again LeNiesha!!

I had just adopted a dog and had to get all of the necessary supplies (and I had a LIST). I figured I would stay local and check out Doggie Style Pets in NoLibs, and I’m so glad I did. The store had everything I needed; crates, toys, food, grooming supplies, etc. What was even better was the staff. Ron went above and beyond that day to make sure I had everything I needed, and that I would be able to get it all home.
I’ve been back to the store several times since that day and have had nothing but incredible experiences. I will absolutely recommend this store to everyone!
Donathan did a great job grooming my large and anxious dog and in record time. Highly recommend!
5 stars mainly for Rons kindness and customer service! seriously one of the nicest ppl ive ever met and i appreciate his help each time i come in!
Tabs - ma girl but all the people that work here are truly my people because they give my baby buttercup unique attention always! Thank you for all that you all do!

Went in today to get a Kelly Green Eagles jersey for our golden doodle and the lady working took her time to give our dog phoebe so much love and let her try on the jersey to make sure it fit perfect! Excellent service and store! Great products, selection of toys and treats!

Good store overall I like all the locations a lot but lately this store is never open. Every time I come it seems like they have the we’ll be back sign on their front door. I would call before you make your way over to check someone is there.

Donathan is great. I brought my ~50 lb doodle mix in for a bath and mini cut and she looks and smells so much better. It’s exactly what I was looking for. Other groomers often cut her face way too much, she ends up looking like a different dog (not in a good way). Donathan did just enough to clean her up but she still looks cute. My dog is super nervous about going to the groomers, but she seemed happy and much calmer when I picked her up. Recommend!

Just had a grooming appointment for our small dog and had a great experience! The team was super friendly when we got to the shop and my dog came out looking so cute :) We asked for a bit of a trim since the weather is still cold and they delivered. The shop also has a lot of fun toys, treats, equipment, and outfits for your furry babies. Will definitely be going back!

Great local store. Friendly staff, clean store and plenty of choices for a variety of items (toys, treats, snacks, clothes). My pup knows how to navigate his way to this store anywhere in northern liberties.

Brought my dog in for a simple bath with nail trim. I thought they had a great selection which allowed me to pick exactly what I needed for good cost. I feel like some planes make it that you can only get full bath with grooming etc, where I just need something simple for less money. Which I could get here. Jonathan was great and my dog seemed calm after!
theyvdo an amazing job
Started to bring my dog here for his grooms, and Donathan does a great job! Also super nice! Would recommend!
Always the best place for dog snacks and grooming! Donathan did such a great job with our puppy’s grooming service. Would recommend to any pet owners in the area.
Donathan is great! My baby Sassy has a ton and energy and like to play . Donathan is very patient with her and takes his time.  We always leave happy and satisfied!

I brought my 3 year old pug here for his first grooming since we moved to Philly. It was quick, (30 minutes-ish), friendly groomers and staff, easy to book! Just a little pricey as someone who isn’t used to living in the city, but I want the best for my little guy and this place is just that!

I truly loved my dogs groomer, we did a premium bath and teeth brush. My puppy is very high energy and gets the zoomies after a bath, so it was really great to hear that he was OK with everything and he really helped me get my puppy altogether so I only have good things to say. Will be back!
Donathan did great with grooming our dog Max! He clearly knows how to handle large dogs and made Max look very pretty. Will be coming back for future grooming

Nyim G helped me today and he was wonderful! My dogs harness was not a good fit for him. He was all over the place and Nyim was so patient and kind and helped us find a much better fit and it’s reflective!
Friendly service. Quick bath and cut!

Our dog will not let us walk her without a daily stop in this store. This is Penelope modeling her fresh groom from the Poplar location. We love the staff here especially Alex & Ricardo. We are all so sad Ricardo moved on to his next store, although, he definitely deserves it more than anyone!!  We miss him! 🐶 …
Always greeted with a warm welcome when visiting. I look forward to seeing Nyim G. at the store!
nyim was an incredible help for our new pup! highly recommend visiting this store they will help with all your needs !!
Nyim was great, staying after hours!
Bought a ton of stuff for my new puppy and got great help from the fabulous staff. Nayeme is always incredibly dedicated and helpful! He is knowledgeable and an advocate for the resident pups.
